purpose: Teach: コロコロ/サブタイトル/タイツ/トラバ/スバ/ジモン/背番号/ケタ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがコロコロボールのおもちゃを下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he's going to give you that rolling ball toy.
lines.style: Warm, gentle delivery. Slight lift on Sho's name to catch his attention. Measured pace, soft and informative. A small smile in the voice — delighting in the news she's delivering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「映画のサブタイトルを覚える遊び」したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I played this game where we'd remember movie subtitles.
lines.style: Quick, bright opening. Proud of the memory. Natural child's rhythm — eager to share but not hyperactive. Genuine delight, not performing. Small pause before the detail.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「冬の防寒にタイツがいい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that tights are really good for staying warm in winter.
lines.style: Thoughtful, conversational tone. No rush. Slight wondering quality — sharing something practical he mentioned. Warm delivery, like she's relaying wisdom gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「ブログのトラバ、つまりトラックバックの仕組み」を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me how trackbacks work on blogs — you know, the whole mechanism.
lines.style: Earnest, engaged tone. Not quite mastering the concept but proud of the effort. Small exhale of accomplishment. Speaking carefully, like he's still processing it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「フィジーの首都スバはきれい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was telling me that Suva, the capital of Fiji, is really beautiful.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly dreamy. Soft opening. Pacing is unhurried — she's picturing it as she speaks. Gentle delivery, sharing something that charmed him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと寺門ジモンのグルメ番組観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I watched that gourmet show with Jimon Teramori.
lines.style: Light, animated delivery. Quick bright rhythm. Genuine excitement — the kind of eager joy that comes from a shared experience. No pretense, just delight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「サッカーの背番号10は特別」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that the number 10 in soccer is really special.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly reverent tone. Moderate pace. Respect in the voice — she understands the significance he places on it. Gentle and attentive delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「ケタ違いの努力が必要」って言われたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad told me that you need effort on an entirely different level to succeed.
lines.style: Serious but not heavy. Absorbing the weight of what he said. Quiet thoughtfulness. Slight pause before the final phrase — letting it settle. Earnest, processing the lesson.
